The former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Meloria]] went into self-imposed exile on an '''island''' on the [[Boiling Sea]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall/Legends|Drall]]. The island was home to a cave in which Meloria lived, as well as multiple [[Tree/Legends|trees]], footpaths, cliffs, [[ibbot]] roosts, and a beach.<ref name="CatCW" />
